pilot: 2023 DSE Reading Part A Super Curation

checklist.requirement: Source text remains intact; all sentence intervals cover the original with no missing non-whitespace characters.
All 22 questions, their tables, choices, instructions and subparts remain available.
Original question analysis pages 35–321, rich formatting, supplemental pages and source provenance are retained.
Question 21 includes both evidence-supported positions, explicitly tied to the supplied analysis.
Fixed five-stage rail; independently scrolling guide, original source and evidence bank.
Reading-specific progression: orientation, sentence reading, question evidence, complete analysis, answer/source verification.
One decision at a time; no future evidence marks after Back; animations cannot produce stale state.
Every evidence occurrence is matched by paragraph and exact character offsets.
Attempt before demonstration; blank attempts receive an explicit choice before revealing guidance.
Reject candidates with a reason; distinguish rejected responses from valid source evidence already used.
Each of 74 answer evidence visits is a separate reversible step.
Source previews preserve context, return without moving the main page, drag by header, resize from four corners, and remain in viewport.
Keyboard movement/resizing, focus return, visible focus, reduced-motion and animation interruption.
Chinese teaching notes; existing account-loaded Chinese source translations can be toggled. Missing translations point to original supplementary reference.
Bookmarks, searchable step navigation, manual understood state, local account-scoped autosave and three save slots.
JSON export/import round trip; invalid versions or malformed files never overwrite progress.
Local storage failure is visible; learning and export remain possible.
Reading exercise answers and the prior deep-analysis interface are unchanged after opening and closing curation.
Entry is limited to 2023 A standalone practice; other years and full-paper mocks do not gain the entry.
Desktop 1440 and 1100; tablet 768; phone 390; 720x450 equivalent to a 1440x900 viewport at 200% zoom.

adaptations: Paper 3 task A/B/C colors are replaced with reading evidence, logical-relation and language cues, with labels.
Paper 3 listening playback and timed podcast notes do not apply to this reading paper; reading proceeds in immutable source order.
Paper 3 essay construction becomes question-by-question answer verification; open answers are not judged by exact-string matching.
Progress is local to this device and account, clearly labelled; no new database or scoring changes.
